underlines.text: Louisa, you will not mind my waking Mr. Hurst

reference.text: Mr. Hurst had, therefore, nothing to do but to stretch himself on one of the sofas and go to sleep.

underlines.text: He began to feel the danger of paying Elizabeth too much attention

reference.text: He was as much awake to the novelty of attention in that quarter as Elizabeth herself could be, and unconsciously closed his book.
